fields.source_first_note: Read the entire long Jabir field, including every appended version clause. The main report gives the father’s debt, proposed this-year-date crop, creditors’ insufficiency belief, invitation/notification instruction, visit with Abu Bakr and Umar, prayer for blessing, full debt payment and thirteen-wasq remainder with both7/6 alternatives, then the Maghrib encounter and joint Companion reply. Retain the this-year/crop scope and the parenthetic notify-me imperative; the mirbad drying-place definition is lexical context. The initial multistep route is context. In the tail, distinguish Hisham’s expressly supplied Asr-time/Jabir-attendance variant from the compiler’s no-Abu-Bakr/no-laughter omission comparison; retain the actual thirty-wasq father-debt addition under the explicitly printed Jabir voice as a qualified same-family transmitted clause. The terminal Ibn-Ishaq route merely mentions Dhuhr prayer without an actual new visit predicate; preserve it as comparison/source context and disclose all timing variants rather than choosing one. No missing actual attendance, uncertainty speaker or canonical link is invented.

Read all own Urdu words independently. Preserve the this-year-date-fruit offer, refusal reason, actual tell-me imperative, Prophet visit and blessing, all debts paid, thirteen remaining and both explicit seven/six allocation alternatives. Jabir’s Maghrib encounter and the Abu Bakr/Umar joint reply are actual supplied content. Only the mirbad definition is lexical context within this main body. The appended Hisham/Wahb/Jabir wording expressly supplies Asr and Jabir attendance, then omission-only commentary about Abu Bakr/laughter, then the finite thirty-wasq father-debt addition with its printed Jabir attribution. Keep substantive variant/addition separate and qualified in the same family; the final Ibn-Ishaq Dhuhr-prayer mention lacks a supplied new event and remains visible source comparison. Preserve routes/context and do not harmonize the Maghrib/Asr/Dhuhr wording.

Read the complete chain and short Jarir pledge report. The actual report is Jarir’s first-person pledge and the stipulated goodwill toward every Muslim. Keep coherent final hearing/Jarir framing; earlier pure multistep route is context. No prayer/zakat conditions are printed here and none should be inserted from2715.

Own entire field supplies Jarir’s pledge and the actual every-Muslim goodwill condition. Earlier Abu Nuaym/Sufyan transmission route can stay context, retaining the final Ziyad-heard-Jarir frame and all actual pledge wording. Do not add the next occurrence’s other conditions or merge the source identities.

Read full original. After the pure prefatory route, Jarir ibn Abdullah expressly reports pledging to establish prayer, pay zakat and give goodwill to every Muslim. All three source conditions and their universal recipient domain remain; no separate commentary or lexical marker is printed.

Read the complete own Urdu route and Jarir statement. Retain the final actual reporter framing and all three pledging conditions: prayer, zakat and خیر خواہی toward every Muslim. Earlier multistep chain is context only. This is Jarir’s transmitted first-person report of his pledge, not an invented direct quotation by the Prophet.
